title: Finite-range dependency coloring gives independent Bernoulli outputs and a measurable exact product residual

statement.quantifiers: Countably infinite torsion-free G, a,b,c in F2[G] with ab=1, ac=0 and c nonzero; P=1−BA, K=imP, S=supp(1−ba), d=|SS^-1|.
statement.assertion: K^(d+1) is measurably pmp G-isomorphic to X times a fiber residual R. On a conull free seed, a d-color dependency graph yields T_eta:K^d→X and an equivariant coordinatewise finite linear right inverse S_eta. The inverse product map is (y,(eta,r))→(eta,r+S_eta y).
assumptions: Actual group-ring witness and torsion-free companion construction supplied/independently validated.
Haar mixing factor K with a nonzero finite-support configuration, giving essential freeness.
Kechris–Solecki–Todorcevic bounded-degree Borel coloring theorem in its exact stated scope.

inputs: Seed eta in conull free K, d independent Haar reservoirs, idempotent finite-range projection P.
outputs: Conditionally iid fair output, independent entire residual, explicit forward/inverse pmp equivariant maps.
interface.precision: Exact measurable existence, no approximation or finite-window-only independence.
costs: No finite-bit or effective coloring algorithm is supplied.
Group word equality/support sizes and torsion-free witness cannot be silently treated as acquired.
The residual remains; no inverse for the canonical countable factor or measurable cancellation supplied.

proof_mechanism: Color intersecting input windows using the free seed action.
Same-color disjoint windows and different-color independent reservoirs yield a full iid field.
Finite-support toggle w_g=P delta_(g s0) changes its selected same-color output alone.
Coordinatewise finite toggle sums give T_eta S_eta=I and residual kernel.
Fixed-seed compact-group isomorphism pushes Haar to full product; equivariance of colors and toggles gives G-conjugacy.
obstructions: A Haar factor, mixing, finite-range dependence or an independent iid factor need not be a Bernoulli generating partition.
Do not substitute the earlier unresolved relative-isomorphism interface for this proof.
Augmentation blocks algebraic absorption, not this measurable splitting with a different residual.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Validate essential freeness, a finite dependency graph and exact equivariant toggles; distinguish iid extraction from residual Bernoullicity and from an effective compiler.

review.source_reported: Source written derivation and finite checks reported, precise original scopes retained; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
